TEXT.source: NTU Corpus stories for Atayal, story: AtaNr-moving_Takun
TEXT.citation: Sung, L. M., Lily, I., Hsieh, F., & Lin, Z. (2008). Developing an online corpus of Formosan languages. Taiwan Journal of Linguistics, 6(2.).

FORM.notes: source note: gingamilan詞根為gamil，指植物生根、抓住土壤。主焦形式為 g<um>amil。 | source note: nanavakis 原意為"年長者"，此處應指"泰雅族人的祖先"。 | source note: 汶水泰雅不同村之間有b/v, c/s等發音上的差異。清安村發音人較年輕一輩的詞彙已無b和c的音，但較年長的發音人的部分詞彙仍保留b和c的音。此篇語料係依照發音人的發音而給予標記。

S.FORM: kala panqu'anaymu ku' gingamilan nku' nanavakis sunga'.
S.PHON: kala panquʔanajmu kuʔ ɣiŋamilan nkuʔ nana*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.FORM: kala panqu'anaymu ku' gingamilan nku' nanavakis sunga'.
S.PHON: kala panquʔanajmu kuʔ ɣiŋamilan nkuʔ nana*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.TRANSL: 我來敘述以前祖先的起源.
I'll describe the origins of our ancestors in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句kia'為表處所，後接表處所名詞，和表存在的kia'句法表現不同。 | source note: 此處原本住在台灣的人，應指所有原住民，但亦可指泛泰雅族人。

S.FORM: tiku gingamilanta' ka navakis sunga' ga minkahul kia papak ru minsa'a'utu'ta' kia kahavag ka ka' a'iani runi i taiwan.
S.PHON: tiku ɣiŋamilantaʔ ka na*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa minkaħul kia papak ru min[s|ɕ]aʔaʔutuʔtaʔ kia kaħa*aɣ ka kaʔ aʔiani runi i taiwan
S.FORM: tiku gingamilanta' ka navakis sunga' ga minkahul kia papak ru minsa'a'utu'ta' kia kahavag ka ka' a'iani runi i taiwan.
S.PHON: tiku ɣiŋamilantaʔ ka na*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa minkaħul kia papak ru min[s|ɕ]aʔaʔutuʔtaʔ kia kaħa*aɣ ka kaʔ aʔiani runi i taiwan
S.TRANSL: 我們祖先的起源來自大霸尖山,原本住在台灣的人們都曾經聚集在那裏.
The origin of our ancestors in the past was from the Papak Mountain, and those who were originally here in Taiwan had all been aggregated there.

FORM.notes: source note: tuliq原意為"起身"，此處有"突然間"的語意。

S.FORM: tuliq ru wahan na vayhu la wahan na vayhu ru siluhey ku papak ru.
S.PHON: tuliq ru waħan na *ajħu la waħan na *ajħu ru [s|ɕ]iluħej ku papak ru
S.FORM: tuliq ru wahan na vayhu la wahan na vayhu ru siluhey ku papak ru.
S.PHON: tuliq ru waħan na *ajħu la waħan na *ajħu ru [s|ɕ]iluħej ku papak ru
S.TRANSL: 突然間,風災就來了,然後風災來了之後大霸尖山就倒塌了.
Suddenly, a typhoon came, and after that the Papak mountain collapsed.

FORM.notes: source note: itaal 原專指泰雅族人，但因此處為敘述起源之說，宜翻譯為原住民。

S.FORM: masugagai kumiyum su naniqun kahavag ku itaal runi taiwan ru.
S.PHON: ma[s|ɕ]uɣaɣai kumijum [s|ɕ]u naniqun kaħa*aɣ ku itaal runi taiwan ru
S.FORM: masugagai kumiyum su naniqun kahavag ku itaal runi taiwan ru.
S.PHON: ma[s|ɕ]uɣaɣai kumijum [s|ɕ]u naniqun kaħa*aɣ ku itaal runi taiwan ru
S.TRANSL: 原本住在台灣的人們就分開去尋找食物.
All the people originally living here in Taiwan then separated to look for food.

FORM.notes: source note: yumiax應指"下山"的動作。

S.FORM: aruwa yumiax tigi karinku ku ruma' muwah tigi taoyuan ku ruma' muwah tigi vari ku ruma' musa nantou ku ruma'.
S.PHON: aruwa jumiax tiɣi karinku ku rumaʔ muwaħ tiɣi taojuan ku rumaʔ muwaħ tiɣi *ari ku rumaʔ mu[s|ɕ]a nantou ku rumaʔ
S.FORM: aruwa yumiax tigi karinku ku ruma' muwah tigi taoyuan ku ruma' muwah tigi vari ku ruma' musa nantou ku ruma'.
S.PHON: aruwa jumiax tiɣi karinku ku rumaʔ muwaħ tiɣi taojuan ku rumaʔ muwaħ tiɣi *ari ku rumaʔ mu[s|ɕ]a nantou ku rumaʔ
S.TRANSL: 有些人往下到了花蓮;有些人來到桃園;有些人來到苗栗;有些人去到了南投.
Some went downward to Hualien; some came to Taoyuan; some came to Miaoli; some went to Nantou.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句kia'表"那時"，和存在句以及表處所之用法不同。因此有三種語法功能不同的kia':(1) kia' 存在; (2) kia' 處所; (3)kia' 那時。

S.FORM: suoyi tiku hani la ga ini' paska' kahavag na'aring kia ini' paska' ku kai'ta' ka itaal XXXX la ru.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uoji tiku ħani la ɣa iniʔ pa[s|ɕ]kaʔ kaħa*aɣ naʔariŋ kia iniʔ pa[s|ɕ]kaʔ ku kaiʔtaʔ ka itaal xxxx la ru
S.FORM: suoyi tiku hani la ga ini' paska' kahavag na'aring kia ini' paska' ku kai'ta' ka itaal XXXX la ru.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uoji tiku ħani la ɣa iniʔ pa[s|ɕ]kaʔ kaħa*aɣ naʔariŋ kia iniʔ pa[s|ɕ]kaʔ ku kaiʔtaʔ ka itaal xxxx la ru
S.TRANSL: 所以現在大家彼此都不同了.自從那時候泰雅族的語言就都彼此不相像了.
So, now we are all different from each other. Our languages of the Atayal people have all become different since then.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句muvaq為"下到"之意，表動作的方式為"往下"且有"到達"目的地。IU16之yumiax則是只有表動作"往下"。

S.FORM: tiku muvaq runi i vari hani ga taiyazu salun ku minuka muvaq vari ga aqih gi qaisun ragiax la ga ini' paska' ku hanaang na ka kai' la gi.
S.PHON: tiku mu*aq runi i *ari ħani ɣa taija*u [s|ɕ]alun ku minuka mu*aq *ari ɣa aqiħ ɣi qai[s|ɕ]un raɣiax la ɣa iniʔ pa[s|ɕ]kaʔ ku ħanaaŋ na ka kaiʔ la ɣi
S.FORM: tiku muvaq runi i vari hani ga taiyazu salun ku minuka muvaq vari ga aqih gi qaisun ragiax la ga ini' paska' ku hanaang na ka kai' la gi.
S.PHON: tiku mu*aq runi i *ari ħani ɣa taija*u [s|ɕ]alun ku minuka mu*aq *ari ɣa aqiħ ɣi qai[s|ɕ]un raɣiax la ɣa iniʔ pa[s|ɕ]kaʔ ku ħanaaŋ na ka kaiʔ la ɣi
S.TRANSL: 下到苗栗這裡的,就稱做為泰雅族.但是因為被山脈隔開,語言的腔調就彼此不相像.
Those who came downward to Miaoli here are called the Atayal people. Since we are separated by the mountains from each other, unfortunately, the accents of our languages do not resemble each other.

S.FORM: vali asi nku zitai sku hani maglu ru maska' ku kai' kia ku ruma' imuliq ku hanaang na kai' kia ku ruma' ga ga mahuay ku kai'nha' ru.
S.PHON: *ali a[s|ɕ]i nku *itai [s|ɕ]ku ħani maɣlu ru ma[s|ɕ]kaʔ ku kaiʔ kia ku rumaʔ imuliq ku ħanaaŋ na kaiʔ kia ku rumaʔ ɣa ɣa maħuaj ku kaiʔnħaʔ ru
S.FORM: vali asi nku zitai sku hani maglu ru maska' ku kai' kia ku ruma' imuliq ku hanaang na kai' kia ku ruma' ga ga mahuay ku kai'nha' ru.
S.PHON: *ali a[s|ɕ]i nku *itai [s|ɕ]ku ħani maɣlu ru ma[s|ɕ]kaʔ ku kaiʔ kia ku rumaʔ imuliq ku ħanaaŋ na kaiʔ kia ku rumaʔ ɣa ɣa maħuaj ku kaiʔnħaʔ ru
S.TRANSL: 不像現在的時代每天聚集在一起,語言才會彼此相向.(因為被山脈隔開)有一些人語言的腔調比較重,有些人他們的語言腔調比較溫和謙遜.

It wasn't like the modern era when we gather around everyday, so that the languages resemble each other. (Because being separated by mountains,) there are some people with heavy accents, and there are those whose language sounds moderate.

FORM.notes: source note: 在苗栗山區的泰雅族有稱作Matu'au和Matu'uwal的由來是，前者族人回話時說"是/好"講"'au"，後者則是說"'uwal"。因此Matu'au和Matu'uwal字面上意思為"說'au為是/好"的人以及"說'uwal為是/好"的人"。 | source note: 此處腔調重的族群指的是Matu'uwal(即清安村、此篇語料發音人的方言)，由於該方言保留較多的喉塞音，因此聽起來較艱澀難懂。Matu'au的方言(清安村族人稱其為"澤敖利")則是較少喉塞音，因此聽起來較滑順、溫和。

S.FORM: kia ku san mha matu'au kia ku san mha matu'uwal.
S.PHON: kia ku [s|ɕ]an mħa matuʔau kia ku [s|ɕ]an mħa matuʔuwal
S.FORM: kia ku san mha matu'au kia ku san mha matu'uwal.
S.PHON: kia ku [s|ɕ]an mħa matuʔau kia ku [s|ɕ]an mħa matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 有些人(的語言)就稱作Matu'au,有些人(的語言)就稱做Matu'uwal.
There are those who are (whose language is) called Matu'au, and there are those who are (whose language is) called Matu'uwal.

S.FORM: ru' tiku sami ka mavatu'an hani hiya' ga na'aring sami i kia muwah ru ukas vay naniqun.
S.PHON: ruʔ tiku [s|ɕ]ami ka ma*atuʔan ħani ħijaʔ ɣa naʔariŋ [s|ɕ]ami i kia muwaħ ru uka[s|ɕ] *aj naniqun
S.FORM: ru' tiku sami ka mavatu'an hani hiya' ga na'aring sami i kia muwah ru ukas vay naniqun.
S.PHON: ruʔ tiku [s|ɕ]ami ka ma*atuʔan ħani ħijaʔ ɣa naʔariŋ [s|ɕ]ami i kia muwaħ ru uka[s|ɕ] *aj naniqun
S.TRANSL: 而我們在Mavatu'an這裡,自從我們來了之後就真的都沒有食物.
As for us, the people of Mavatu'an here, since we had come, there really wasn't any food.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句發音人表示kina為"跟/和"之意。

S.FORM: asi paglu kina qasinu gi kia ukas a patus sunga' gi vali kia a qavuli' uwi X.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]i paɣlu kina qa[s|ɕ]inu ɣi kia uka[s|ɕ] a patu[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣi *ali kia a qa*uliʔ uwi x
S.FORM: asi paglu kina qasinu gi kia ukas a patus sunga' gi vali kia a qavuli' uwi X.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]i paɣlu kina qa[s|ɕ]inu ɣi kia uka[s|ɕ] a patu[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣi *ali kia a qa*uliʔ uwi x
S.TRANSL: 只能和野獸在一起,因為以前沒有槍,也沒有火藥.
We had no choice but stay together with the beasts because there were no guns in the past, and no gun powder either.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句有兩種獵刀說法，前者puting為澤傲利方言(Matu'au)的說法，後者takis為Matu'uwal方言的說法。

S.FORM: nanak ku puting takis vay ku rasunmian ru.
S.PHON: nanak ku putiŋ taki[s|ɕ] *aj ku ra[s|ɕ]unmian ru
S.FORM: nanak ku puting takis vay ku rasunmian ru.
S.PHON: nanak ku putiŋ taki[s|ɕ] *aj ku ra[s|ɕ]unmian ru
S.TRANSL: 我們所攜帶的真的只有獵刀.
What we brought were really only the hunting knives.

S.FORM: iniwan na qasinu kinqiyanuxmian sunga' i.
S.PHON: iniwan na qa[s|ɕ]inu kinqijanuxmian [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ i
S.FORM: iniwan na qasinu kinqiyanuxmian sunga' i.
S.PHON: iniwan na qa[s|ɕ]inu kinqijanuxmian [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ i
S.TRANSL: 我們過去的生活就和野獸一樣.
Our lives in the past were the same as those of the beasts.

S.FORM: talan qutux qasinu ga tutingun ru nanu yani ku siqiyanux nku sami ka itaal hani.
S.PHON: talan qutux qa[s|ɕ]inu ɣa tutiŋun ru nanu jani ku [s|ɕ]iqijanux nku [s|ɕ]ami ka itaal ħani
S.FORM: talan qutux qasinu ga tutingun ru nanu yani ku siqiyanux nku sami ka itaal hani.
S.PHON: talan qutux qa[s|ɕ]inu ɣa tutiŋun ru nanu jani ku [s|ɕ]iqijanux nku [s|ɕ]ami ka itaal ħani
S.TRANSL: 如果看到一隻野獸,就把牠打死,我們這裡的泰雅族人就是靠這個維生.
If we saw a beast, we beat it, and that was what we, the Atayal people here, depended on when living.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句maqahaquaw為"順勢下坡"之意，和yumiax"往下"不同。

S.FORM: ru maqahquwawsami ru muwahsami i yahu na papak la ru.
S.PHON: ru maqaħquwaw[s|ɕ]ami ru muwaħ[s|ɕ]ami i jaħu na papak la ru
S.FORM: ru maqahquwawsami ru muwahsami i yahu na papak la ru.
S.PHON: ru maqaħquwaw[s|ɕ]ami ru muwaħ[s|ɕ]ami i jaħu na papak la ru
S.TRANSL: 我們下坡然後就來到大霸尖山的下面.
We went downhill and came to the foot of the Papak Mountain.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句la ku亦可解釋為單一的言談標記lku，但因後有主格論元itaal，此處將其分開標記。

S.FORM: ru lumuag tikay su gaghap na na pati' la ku itaal.
S.PHON: ru lumuaɣ tikaj [s|ɕ]u ɣaɣħap na na patiʔ la ku itaal
S.FORM: ru lumuag tikay su gaghap na na pati' la ku itaal.
S.PHON: ru lumuaɣ tikaj [s|ɕ]u ɣaɣħap na na patiʔ la ku itaal
S.TRANSL: 泰雅人找到了一些稻米的種子.
The Atayal people found some rice seeds.

S.FORM: ki'i vinuway vay nku kamisama' ku yani su kaqiyanux ru.
S.PHON: kiʔi *inuwaj *aj nku kami[s|ɕ]amaʔ ku jani [s|ɕ]u kaqijanux ru
S.FORM: ki'i vinuway vay nku kamisama' ku yani su kaqiyanux ru.
S.PHON: kiʔi *inuwaj *aj nku kami[s|ɕ]amaʔ ku jani [s|ɕ]u kaqijanux ru
S.TRANSL: 大概是上帝的賞賜,那樣才能過活.
That's probably God's gift, so that we can live on in that way.

S.FORM: ta'aringun kia tumuvux.
S.PHON: taʔariŋun kia tumu*ux
S.FORM: ta'aringun kia tumuvux.
S.PHON: taʔariŋun kia tumu*ux
S.TRANSL: 從那時候開始就播種.
From then on we have sowed.

S.FORM: ikia tikay ku irarawq na kahuniq ga pinangun ru ru tuvuxan tikay vali kituwa' ska' suvalay tahunakan.
S.PHON: ikia tikaj ku irarawq na kaħuniq ɣa pinaŋun ru ru tu*uxan tikaj *ali kituwaʔ [s|ɕ]kaʔ [s|ɕ]u*alaj taħunakan
S.FORM: ikia tikay ku irarawq na kahuniq ga pinangun ru ru tuvuxan tikay vali kituwa' ska' suvalay tahunakan.
S.PHON: ikia tikaj ku irarawq na kaħuniq ɣa pinaŋun ru ru tu*uxan tikaj *ali kituwaʔ [s|ɕ]kaʔ [s|ɕ]u*alaj taħunakan
S.TRANSL: 如果有一些樹長得較矮的地方,就拿來開墾,然後播一點種,範圍不大,剛好可以坐下.
If there were some areas with short trees, we cultivated them, and sowed a little bit in some areas that were not large but were really just large enough for one to sit on.

S.FORM: tumuvux ku kaknayril la ga.
S.PHON: tumu*ux ku kaknajril la ɣa
S.FORM: tumuvux ku kaknayril la ga.
S.PHON: tumu*ux ku kaknajril la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 女人們播種.
The women sowed.

S.FORM: ga musa' i qumaluap ku ku tamalung hiya' ru.
S.PHON: ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i qumaluap ku ku tamaluŋ ħijaʔ ru
S.FORM: ga musa' i qumaluap ku ku tamalung hiya' ru.
S.PHON: ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i qumaluap ku ku tamaluŋ ħijaʔ ru
S.TRANSL: 男人們去打獵.
The men went hunting.

S.FORM: ukas a timu' sunga'.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] a timuʔ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.FORM: ukas a timu' sunga'.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] a timuʔ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.TRANSL: 以前沒有鹽.
There was no salt in the past.

S.FORM: nanuan ku timu' sunga' pisa.
S.PHON: nanuan ku timuʔ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ pi[s|ɕ]a
S.FORM: nanuan ku timu' sunga' pisa.
S.PHON: nanuan ku timuʔ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ pi[s|ɕ]a
S.TRANSL: 以前的鹽巴是什麼呢?
What do we have as salt in the past?

FORM.notes: source note: qali'指"樹皮"，panaqali'則為"剝皮"之意。目前不確定此處pa-是否為"非實現"標記。亦不確定na-是否和na-'aring的前綴相同。

S.FORM: tiku pa panaqali' su qali' na kahuniq ka tatimu' rakus ga isamama'ah tikay la ga yani a timu' ru kitku pring ga vuwaynia' ga alan su timu'.
S.PHON: tiku pa panaqaliʔ [s|ɕ]u qaliʔ na kaħuniq ka tatimuʔ raku[s|ɕ] ɣa i[s|ɕ]amamaʔaħ tikaj la ɣa jani a timuʔ ru kitku priŋ ɣa *uwajniaʔ ɣa alan [s|ɕ]u timuʔ
S.FORM: tiku pa panaqali' su qali' na kahuniq ka tatimu' rakus ga isamama'ah tikay la ga yani a timu' ru kitku pring ga vuwaynia' ga alan su timu'.
S.PHON: tiku pa panaqaliʔ [s|ɕ]u qaliʔ na kaħuniq ka tatimuʔ raku[s|ɕ] ɣa i[s|ɕ]amamaʔaħ tikaj la ɣa jani a timuʔ ru kitku priŋ ɣa *uwajniaʔ ɣa alan [s|ɕ]u timuʔ
S.TRANSL: 樹皮如果有鹹味,像是樟樹,如果有點酸酸的,那個就當作鹽巴.羅氏鹽膚木的果實也拿來當作鹽巴.
For the bark of trees that was salty, like that of the camphor trees, if it was a little sour, we made it into salt. For the Rhus javanica tree, its fruits were taken as salt.

FORM.notes: source note: puah為擬聲詞，形容一下子就到達了某處(類似：嘩！一聲就到了)。

S.FORM: ru maqaq muwah lawwi maqahquwaw lawwi ru puah mha vay i mavatu'an la.
S.PHON: ru maqaq muwaħ lawwi maqaħquwaw lawwi ru puaħ mħa *aj i ma*atuʔan la
S.FORM: ru maqaq muwah lawwi maqahquwaw lawwi ru puah mha vay i mavatu'an la.
S.PHON: ru maqaq muwaħ lawwi maqaħquwaw lawwi ru puaħ mħa *aj i ma*atuʔan la
S.TRANSL: 再往下坡就到了Mavatu'an.
As they came down hill a little more, they arrived at Mavatu'an.

FORM.notes: source note: 此句larua譯為"是嗎?"，因陳述時反問旁邊的人而使用。

S.FORM: ru muwah ku gipun la yani ku maymal su kaal ru masiya matupagal su kaal masiyaw larua? ku gipun hani ru.
S.PHON: ru muwaħ ku ɣipun la jani ku majmal [s|ɕ]u kaal ru ma[s|ɕ]ija matupaɣal [s|ɕ]u kaal ma[s|ɕ]ijaw larua ku ɣipun ħani ru
S.FORM: ru muwah ku gipun la yani ku maymal su kaal ru masiya matupagal su kaal masiyaw larua? ku gipun hani ru.
S.PHON: ru muwaħ ku ɣipun la jani ku majmal [s|ɕ]u kaal ru ma[s|ɕ]ija matupaɣal [s|ɕ]u kaal ma[s|ɕ]ijaw larua ku ɣipun ħani ru
S.TRANSL: 然後日本人就來了.日本人在這有超過六十年嗎?
